title: Salary, notice period and joining date
intro: State your numbers clearly and calmly: current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and joining date.
introNative: உங்கள் எண்களைத் தெளிவாகவும் அமைதியாகவும் சொல்லுங்கள்: current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, joining date.

phrases.text: My current CTC is 9 lakhs per annum.
phrases.note: "Per annum" means per year; you can also say "a year".

phrases.text: My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
phrases.native: என் expected CTC 13 லட்சம், ஆனால் இதைப் பற்றிப் பேசத் தயார்.
phrases.note: Give a clear number, then show some flexibility.

phrases.text: My notice period is 60 days, and it's negotiable.
phrases.native: என் notice period 60 நாட்கள்; பேசிக் குறைக்க முடியும்.
phrases.note: "Negotiable" means it can be reduced through discussion.

phrases.text: I can join by the 1st of March.
phrases.note: "By" a date means on or before that date.

phrases.text: I'm flexible on the number if the role is the right fit.
phrases.native: Role எனக்குச் சரியாகப் பொருந்தினால், salary விஷயத்தில் flexible-ஆக இருப்பேன்.
phrases.note: Show that the role matters to you, not only the money.

steps.prompt: HR asks: "What is your expected CTC?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: HR "உங்கள் expected CTC என்ன?" என்று கேட்கிறார். எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: Whatever you feel is fine.
My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
I want minimum 50% hike, otherwise no.
steps.answer: My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
steps.explanation: Give a clear number with some flexibility; don't leave it all to HR or sound rigid.
steps.explanationNative: கொஞ்சம் flexibility-உடன் ஒரு தெளிவான எண்ணைச் சொல்லுங்கள். முழுவதும் HR-இடம் விடவோ, பிடிவாதமாகப் பேசவோ வேண்டாம்.

steps.promptNative: என் notice period 60 நாட்கள்; பேசிக் குறைக்க முடியும்.
steps.answer: My notice period is 60 days, and it's negotiable.

steps.audioText: I can join by the 1st of March.
options: I can join by the 1st of May.
I can't join before the 1st of March.
I can join by the 1st of March.
steps.answer: I can join by the 1st of March.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: What is the CTC you are offering for me?
options: What is the CTC you are offering for me?
Could you share the salary range for this role?
What is the CTC you are offering to me only?
How much CTC you will give for me?
steps.answer: Could you share the salary range for this role?
steps.explanation: Ask politely about the range for the role, and don't use "for me" after "offering".
steps.explanationNative: "Offering for me" தவறு. இந்த role-க்கான salary range-ஐ மரியாதையாகக் கேளுங்கள்.

steps.prompt: HR asks: "When can you join?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: HR "எப்போது join செய்ய முடியும்?" என்று கேட்கிறார். எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: I can join by the 1st of March.
I will join immediately itself.
Once I get the offer, I will see.
steps.answer: I can join by the 1st of March.
steps.explanation: Give a specific date that fits your notice period.
steps.explanationNative: உங்கள் notice period-க்குப் பொருந்தும் ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட தேதியைச் சொல்லுங்கள்.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
options: I will join immediately itself.
I can join immediately.
I will join immediately only.
I can able to join immediately.

steps.answer: My current CTC is 9 lakhs per annum.

steps.audioText: My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
options: My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
My expected CTC is 30 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.
My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, and it's not open for discussion.
steps.answer: My expected CTC is 13 lakhs, but I'm open to discussion.

steps.prompt: Answer HR's questions out loud with your real numbers, in 3–4 sentences: your current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and joining date.
steps.promptNative: HR கேள்விகளுக்கு உங்கள் உண்மையான எண்களுடன் 3–4 வாக்கியங்களில் சத்தமாகப் பதில் சொல்லுங்கள்: current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, joining date.
